parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the instance to which the network interface controller (NIC) is attached.

parameters.name: Ipv6Address
parameters.description: The IPv6 address of the network interface controller (NIC). N indicates that you can configure multiple IPv6 addresses. Valid values of N: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page for paging query. Valid values: 10 to 500.

parameters.name: NetworkInterfaceId
parameters.description: The network interface controller (NIC) ID. Valid values of N: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: NetworkInterfaceName
parameters.description: The name of the network interface controller (NIC). The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain characters under the Unicode letter categorization (including English letters, Chinese characters, and digits). It can also contain colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: **[Deprecated]** Use MaxResults or NextToken for pagination instead.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: **[Deprecated]** Use MaxResults or NextToken for pagination instead.

parameters.name: PrimaryIpAddress
parameters.description: The primary private IP address of the network interface controller (NIC).

parameters.name: PrivateIpAddress
parameters.description: The secondary private IP address of the network interface controller (NIC). Valid values of N: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The resource group ID. When you use this parameter to filter resources, the resource count cannot exceed 1000.

parameters.name: SecurityGroupId
parameters.description: The security group ID associated with the secondary ENI.

parameters.name: ServiceManaged
parameters.description: Specifies whether the user of the network interface controller (NIC) is an Alibaba Cloud service or a Virtual Network Operator (VNO).

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The status of the network interface controller (NIC). Valid values:

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The tag key of the network interface controller (NIC). Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value of the network interface controller (NIC). Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The type of the network interface controller (NIC). Valid values:

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description: The vSwitch ID of the network interface controller (NIC).

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The virtual private cloud (VPC) ID of the network interface controller (NIC).
